name: lm-tiny
hardware: MacBook (M4, mps), or any machine: the count is taken where you train and differs by under 1% between machines

rules: Every op counts: matrix multiplies, attention, FFT, sorts, decompositions, scans and elementwise work.
Count on a real device: the full count (--record) runs every step on the machine that trains.
16 MB: code, tokenizer and weights in one compressed file; the score is for the model loaded from it.
Training text reaches the model only through counted PyTorch steps; training the tokenizer is the one exception.
Evaluation: one forward pass per validation token, no learning at test time.

forbidden_in_train_py.torch\\.compile: torch.compile hides ops from the counter
forbidden_in_train_py.\\btriton\\b|load_inline|cpp_extension|t: custom kernels hide ops from the counter
forbidden_in_train_py.is_meta|device\\.type\\s*==\\s*[\"']meta: code must not check whether it is being counted

required_in_train_py.ev\\.load_artifact: score the model loaded from the artifact
